name: Competitive Bid Advertisements
description: Advertisement of bid requests for purchases and construction work requiring competitive bidding.

preparers.name: Director of Business Services or designee

deadline: Once a week for three weeks
quote: Where competitive bidding is required, the Director of Business Services or designee shall arrange for the advertisement of the bid requests once a week for three (3) weeks in not less than two (2) newspapers of general circulation, as required by law.
